title: Honey
physical_identity: Pastoral field of sunflowers, weeds and an endless wheat field with a beehive and a small lobby/backyard camp, described in letters from Mary to her wife.
scale_topology: Outdoor field stretching to the horizon; wheat field to the south described as infinite; camp with lobby.
anomalies: Weird flower emitting a human-made buzz
Blue flower petal turns to sparkly dust and blooms form a path
lighting_sound: Normal day-night cycle (sunrise ~5 am, sunset ~6 pm per narrators), stars, constant bee buzzing and wind; chilly mornings.
hazards: Getting lost in endless terrain (Gina away 30 days)

entrances.quote: have been asked to investigate this level

signature_mechanic: Peel a petal from the blue flower; dust blooms into a flower path south to the endless wheat field where the lost wife is found.
conflicts_notes: Snapshot begins with page-theme CSS (ignored). Narrator names: Mary, Georgia (wife, also called Gina). Narrators called 'two old grandmas'. Level 139/141 are nav links only.

key_quotes.quote: a beautiful field that seems to stretch out to the horizon and has a normal day-to-night cycle
it immediately turned into a sparkly dust, slipping through my fingers
an infinite wheat field, then stopped abruptly
